name: Fruitadens
sum: One of the smallest known ornithischians, a 65 to 75 cm omnivorous heterodontosaurid from the Late Jurassic Morrison Formation of Colorado.
wsnote: Young adults and the largest known individuals are estimated at 65 to 75 cm long and 0.5 to 0.75 kg.
holotype: Holotype specimen number not read in the sources consulted; a partial skull and skeleton from the Brushy Basin Member of the Morrison Formation at the Fruita Paleontological Area, Colorado.
material: Partial skulls and skeletons of at least four individuals of different ages, from the same area.
biology: Probably bipedal and cursorial; interpreted as an omnivore, and a 2012 skull study suggested a diet of selected plants and possibly insects or other invertebrates.
author: Butler et al. 2010
